stages.title: liked
stages.summary: 已确认（liked）的推荐窗口：2026-10-04 首批 1.1-1.38 + 第二批 1.1-1.15（面板/菜单组）。

windows.title: MainBarPanel
windows.summary: Main skill bar (MainBarPanel.ini, 93 sections; WndFrame 914x116 at 477,357 under Lowest1; ShowModeID=27, script MainBarPanel.lua). Authored frame: Handle_BG1 with 16 slot backgrounds (Image_Bg1..16), Handle_BG2 dynamic backgrounds, kungfu box (Animate_KfAni/Image_KFBright/Box_Kungfu/Image_CD/Text_Kungfu/Text_Page), five pose buttons (Handle_PoZhaos/Handle_PoZhao_1..5), page up/down (Btn_PageUp/Down), lock/updown checkboxes, settings + custom-mode (Wnd_CustomMode/CheckBox_Assisant), shell/gear animates. The slot ICONS, cooldown sweeps and page contents are runtime-filled by MainBarPanel.lua (skill data), so the viewer renders the authored bar (empty slots). INI/authored state only - no GT capture yet.
elements: page up/down, lock/updown, settings, custom-mode, assistant

windows.title: Player
windows.summary: Player frame (Player.ini, 88 sections; WndFrame 398x119 at 301,700 under Normal; script Player.lua). Authored: fight-state backgrounds/animates (Image_FightBG1/Animate_FightBight/Animate_FightTop), back plates (Handle_Back/Image_Back*), HP/mana/energy bars and portrait are runtime-driven by Player.lua (values/buff rows), so the viewer renders the authored frame. INI/authored state only - no GT capture yet.

windows.title: TargetPlayer10
windows.summary: Target frame, player base (TargetPlayer10.ini, 77 sections; script Target.lua). Target.lua opens ui/config/default/<base>.ini (TargetPlayer10/11 for players, Target<Intensity><Relation> for NPCs, +S in standard mode) and APPENDS TargetCommon.ini sections (Handle_TM/MJ/CJ/CangYun by kungfu) into the window's Handle_Energy (AppendItemFromIni, Target.decompiled.lua:967-989). Authored art: Handle_TarBg (Image_TarBgL/C/CR), Handle_FBg, avatar/school, health/mana/sub-health bars, NPC mark, name (Text_Target), cure shield. TargetCommon overlay append replayed (sample kungfu 唐门 Handle_TM, inventory appendIni; other kungfu handles selectable the same way). INI/authored state only - no GT capture yet.
elements: name Text_Target, NPC mark, cure shield
TargetCommon overlay (buffs/cast/class handles) appended at runtime - gap

windows.title: RemainingTimeNotify
windows.summary: The staging/phase countdown notify (ui/Config/Default/RemainingTimeNotify.ini + .lua, PakV4, recovered 2026-10-02): anchored TOPCENTER,0,150; Open(nSeconds) renders the remaining time as big RougeLike.UITex digit frames (frame = digit 0-9, verified frame 3 shows the digit 3) and auto-closes ~5s (OnFrameBreathe); n%60==0 shows Image_Minute + the minutes digits, otherwise Image_Second + the seconds (the lua switches the 分/秒 labels; SFX_Num plays ROUGELIKE_KILL<digit>.pss per digit; Scene/MapWindow8 frames the label). Static render = the 30s state (seconds mode, digits 3/0). The staging phase therefore DOES have displays: this notify (server-driven remaining time), the mode notice panel BattleFieldHSLHNotice (黑山绝境 event notices e.g. 毒蘑菇即将出现/方位提示), and the phase announcements (绝境将在30/20/10秒后开始) which arrive as system messages and render on MainMessageLine (5.8); the safe-zone boundary is engine-drawn (MapCircle + SFX_CircleNew) and BattleFieldMap.Text_Time stays hidden for treasure maps.

windows.title: MainMessageLine
windows.summary: System message line (SYS_MSG); carries the mode announcements (e.g. the streamer-mode warning STR_STORM3) and event calls. Its info segments are runtime-appended clones of Handle_Info (commom items) / Handle_Currency (currency items) / Handle_Money into Handle_MainMessage (MainMessageLine.lua addCommom/addCurrency/addMoney), driven by the SHOW_ITEM list built from Table_GetMessageLineList (ui/Scheme/Case/MessageLineList.txt: 29 show/hide rows in 4 groups 协作/对抗/休闲/其他) and the saved tShow order (default = 网络延迟/时间/WeGame身份码, lua:100-111); Btn_Settings opens the numerical panel (OpenNumericalPanel, lua:1630-1657) where they are toggled. Viewer replay matches the 5.8 Example capture: 网络延迟：100, 时间：2026-08-22 00:31:45, 渲染FPS：34, 逻辑FPS：34 and 飞沙令：0 — five Handle_Info clones flowing right (list flow row; each clone's content block + highlight resized to its measured content width via adjust); titles carry the Lua's `.. g_tStrings.STR_COLON` (lua:5755/6297), values are static samples colored by the Lua's own schemes via the new `fontScheme` text override (getPingFont ≤300ms → 105 green2; getFPSFont 20-39 → 101 orange2, lua:465-531; the real values come from GetPing/GetFPS/Get3DEngineFPS/the date and the currency data); the static template blocks (Handle_Currency/Handle_Info/Handle_Money/Handle_Camp, incl. the editor test text 45646545) are hidden; the per-item `Image_HighlightI` plate (Common.UITex frame 4 — a bright-cored plate, no Lua driver) is dropped from the clones (list template `hide`), matching the 5.8 GT (no plate behind the items); `Image_Glassmorphism` (770x32, PanelBg.UITex frame 6 — a white mask for the engine's backdrop blur, ImageType=16) is hidden: the viewer's frosted-plate stand-in would overhang the 22-tall bar by 10px, and the GT bar is uniform with no glass tint (the blur is invisible over the dark LineBg; unlike the MiddleMap/queue panels where the frosted glass is visible in captures).

windows.title: ACC_TreasureFinal
windows.summary: 寻宝（绝境）最终结算 (1920x700, module ACC_TreasureFinal, script ui/Config/Default/BattleField/ACC_TreasureFinal.lua). The title band (Handle_Title) shows the team rank (Text_Rank = FormatString(STR_TREASURE_RANK, nRank, nTotal), badge art Image_Title/Image_TitleBg1 from Table_GetTreasureInfoTitle and the big digits Handle_Rank Image_Num1/Num2/Image_Ming), rank 1-3 also play Handle_SFX SFX_Copper/Silver/Gold. The my-team rows clone Handle_Player inside Handle_FinalList (Update: rows = GetMyTeamMemberData(nTeamID) sorted by field 12; TemplateGetRowData maps Name->Text_PlayerName, DECAPITATE_COUNT->Text_KillNum, KILL_COUNT->Text_XSNum, BEST_ASSIST_KILL_COUNT->Text_BestZGNum, HARM_OUTPUT->Text_HarmNum, SPECIAL_OP_3->Text_JJFenNum, SPECIAL_OP_6->Text_ResultNum; per-row AWARD_1/2/3 in Handle_Reward -> Image_AwardIcon frames on ui/Image/UITga/DesertStorm.UITex + Text_AwardNum). Handle_Fail/Handle_Win carry the ZS ribbon state art, the header labels live in Handle_Titile (STR_FBLIST_DUIYUANMINGZI/STR_TIPS7/STR_BF_KILL1/STR_BF_ZJZG/STR_BF_DAMAGE/STR_SHOW/STR_SHOW2/STR_GETCITY_JIANGLI), Text_Time = STR_BATTLEFIELD_TIME_USED, Text_WarningTime = STR_NEW_BANISH_1..2 banishing countdown, Btn_Leave -> LeaveALLBattleField (Text_Leave = STR_UISET_BFCENCEL), Btn_Export -> ExportData (Text_Export = STR_FACELIST_DAOCHUMIANJU, STR_CONTENST_INFO_EXPORT_SUCCESS), Wnd_PersonCard opens the clicked member's PersonalCard. Sample rows are placeholders in the window's real formats: Text_Line = '/' so Text_KillNum+Line+XSNum read as the 击/助 pair, Text_BestZGNum = 最佳助攻, Text_HarmNum is 万-formatted, Text_JJFenNum = 本场表现分, Text_ResultNum = 个人评分结算; the rank badge keeps the INI's authored digits (第18名) and Text_Rank carries the matching 队伍排名 text. The PVPUI12 chrome (LockShowAndHide=1) stays off. The window ships no opaque background: its only backdrop art is the semi-transparent veil Image_Bg1 (PVPShowFinal1 frame 11, ImageType=12, ~23% alpha) plus the row bands, composed over the live game world on the client, so the viewer renders it over a neutral tone (`backdrop` #33393E) instead of black; with the personal-card column out of scope the table block is centered on the window (Handle_Titile 403, Handle_FinalList 415). Verified against the capture (downscaled 1/1.73 to design px): button labels follow the engine's WndButton NormalFont, not the child Text scheme (Btn_Leave scheme 3 = 16px white, Btn_Export scheme 18 = 15px white - the authored Text_Leave 28/Text_Export 27 are copy-paste leftovers; 25% of shipped buttons differ), the banishing countdown is the runtime AppendItemFromString sequence in Handle_WarningTime (将在 f257 / seconds f258 yellow2 / 秒后传出战场 f257, viewer `appends` with flow), and the 击/助 pair packs tight because Text_Line is AutoSize=1 PosType=9 (the viewer now measures AutoSize text instead of using the authored box). 导出数据 is hidden per the user's call (the capture shows it, but the viewer drops it: hide Btn_Export). The window is a full-screen overlay centred on the screen (the editor parks the root at (screen-window)/2), so the viewer renders it inside a 1920x1080 screen frame (`screenWidth`/`screenHeight`) with the window centred on the neutral backdrop - the veil reads as the in-game band instead of filling the render.

windows.title: ExitPanel
windows.summary: Client exit / return confirm dialog (420x108, anchored TOPCENTER,TOPCENTER,0,360 below the screen top; ShowModeID 27,26,24,22,12,36). OpenExitPanel(szReason) sets Text_ExitGame from g_tStrings: close -> EXIT_QUIT 你确定要退出游戏吗？, loginclose -> EXIT_LOGIN_QUIT 你确定要退出游戏吗？, returntologin -> EXIT_RETURN_LOGIN 你确定要返回到登录吗？, returntorole -> EXIT_RETURN_CHOOSE 你确定要返回到角色选择吗？ (ExitPanel.lua). Btn_Sure (确定, STR_SURE) exits the game / ReInitUI by the reason, Btn_Cancel (取消, STR_CANCEL) plus Esc/Enter close it. Image_Back is a runtime full-screen dimmer: UpdateBgImageSize sizes it to Station.GetClientSize() and pins it to the window origin; it stays hidden in the static render (screen context, like the world backdrop). The warning icon and the glass PanelBg/PanelBg18 ornaments come from UItimate. The shipped Text_ExitGame leaves HAlign at the left default although its 241-wide box is glued to the icon (76..348, group centred on the 420 dialog) and no shipped reason fills it, so the viewer centres the message in its box (`adjust hAlign=1`) and moves the icon to the message's left edge (Image_Warning left=124, the authored 76 assumed a full-width message); re-open when a capture of the live dialog is available.
elements: 你确定要退出游戏吗？ prompt (Text_ExitGame, runtime-set from EXIT_*)
确定 / 取消 buttons (Btn_Sure / Btn_Cancel)
Runtime full-screen dimmer (Image_Back, client-size at runtime)

windows.summary: Per-map queue rows with elapsed time, cancel menu and the auto-enter checkbox; fed by OnSyncMapQueueInfo. Handle_Content/_0 are parked prototypes cloned per queued map by AppendItemFromIni into Handle_List, so the default hides them and injects one authored row. UpdateListSize (MapQueue.decompiled.lua:667-745) resizes the list/bg/checkbox from the row count and then calls Collapse (lua:330-376), which sets the window to 32 + rows*48 + 32 (112 for one row) and shows Wnd_List; the inventory adjust list carries those one-row values.
